title: Dexcom G7 15 day sensor, backfill not working.
symptom: Backfill is not working on the new Dexcom G7 15 day sensor. xDrip nightly build works with the sensors and can receive data, warmup worked perfectly, but backfill does not work. The official Dexcom app does backfill data correctly.
fix: Update to any Nightly release after 2026.04.01. The issue was resolved in a nightly build, and testing for two weeks showed no issue with backfill.
evidence_quote: Update to any Nightly release after 2026.04.01 and this should be working fine.
